assessments.zone: Beni city core neighbourhoods (Kanzulinzuli, Butsili, Madrandele, Kasanga, Tamende, Mabakanga, Ndindi) and the city record
assessments.evidence: Beni is the seat of the military-run city administration under the state of siege and of the FARDC Grand Nord operations command, with permanent PNC police stations handling order and arrests in the neighbourhoods; no armed group holds any part of the city centre, where insecurity is mainly crime and sporadic ADF infiltration. Not verified against 2026 reporting: web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted, news/monitoring sites blocked by the egress proxy).

assessments.zone: Peripheral north-eastern/eastern neighbourhoods exposed to ADF raids (Boikene, Kasabinyole, Tuungane, Malepe incl. Beu/Rwangoma side)
assessments.evidence: These outer neighbourhoods toward Mavivi airport, Ngadi and the Rwangoma/Beu forest edge have seen recurrent night-time ADF incursions and killings (notably 2019-2022), leading to heavy FARDC deployment and MONUSCO presence (Boikene base), but the state retains permanent police and military posts and the ADF has never held them. Not verified against 2026 reporting: web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted, news/monitoring sites blocked by the egress proxy).

units.CD6109-beni: Beni city is firmly state-held. Since the May 2021 state of siege the city has been run by military/police officers, the FARDC Sokola 1 Grand Nord operational command and joint FARDC-UPDF (Shujaa) operations against the ADF are based here, and MONUSCO keeps a base at Boikene/Mavivi. Day-to-day order, arrests and justice in the neighbourhoods are handled by the PNC, under the military-run city administration. The ADF does not hold any part of the city but has repeatedly raided peripheral neighbourhoods on the north-eastern and eastern edges (Boikene, Rwangoma/Beu, Mavivi-Ngadi side), and urban crime and youth (Mai-Mai/Wazalendo-linked) unrest occur. The AFC/M23 front lies far to the south in Lubero and has not reached Beni. Live web research was unavailable for this unit, so the assessment rests on the record up to mid-2026 and background knowledge. Reviewer pass (2026-10-01) could not verify either (web search budget exhausted, fetch targets blocked); assessment kept as plausible on background knowledge.
